headline: Premier League recap: Villa defeat Newcastle, Haaland with brace in Man City win
description: Aston Villa were able to get a crucial away win against Newcastle, while there were more goals for Erling Haaland as Manchester City defeated Ipswich Town.

headline: Man City's winning ways continue to block out the noise
description: Manchester City face an uncertain future, but Enzo Maresca's side continue to deliver on the pitch despite the distractions.

headline: Johan Manzambi fires Aston Villa to victory at St. James' Park
description: Johan Manzambi scored the only goal of the game as Aston Villa clinched a 1-0 win over Newcastle at St James' Park.

headline: Enzo Maresca plays down Erling Haaland injury fears after Man City star limps off
description: Enzo Maresca has played down fears over Erling Haaland's fitness after the striker limped off at the end of Manchester City's 3-2 win over Ipswich.

headline: Andoni Iraola questions VAR; says Szoboszlai, Frimpong out 'for some time'
description: Andoni Iraola questioned the decision to overturn a penalty awarded to Liverpool in the first half of their 2-1 win at Brentford and shared injury concerns over Dominic Szoboszlai and Jeremie Frimpong after both were forced off.

headline: Premier League VAR review: Should Brentford's Yarmoliuk have been sent off vs. Liverpool?
description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.
